entries.fact: Concluding secondary-school physics; centuries of worldwide study of matter, motion, structure and properties.
Physics seeks general natural laws applicable to Earth and the universe.
General laws explain specific processes and support a connected physical picture.
Mechanical-world heading; Newton-era hard, massive, impenetrable, indestructible moving particles; composition/motion account; historical quotation.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Do not teach indivisible hard particles as present-day atomic physics.

entries.fact: Newtonian motion applied to celestial bodies, sand and wind; historical confidence; Lagrange/France/Newton quotation.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Bound Newtonian accuracy and preserve quotation as textbook attribution.

entries.fact: Electromagnetism challenged the purely mechanical world picture.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Insufficiency of mechanics alone, not denial of useful mechanical motion equations.

entries.fact: Maxwell introduced electromagnetic field laws distinct from Newtonian mechanics.
Electromagnetic-world heading; instantaneous Newtonian action contrasted with finite-speed field mediation.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Do not generalize all interactions or all objects to electromagnetic interaction.

entries.fact: Electromagnetic effects from nuclei/atoms/molecules to astronomical radiation.
Historical attempt at an exclusively electromagnetic unified picture.
Special relativity, finite signal propagation, spacetime and high-speed motion.
Historical ether mechanics contrasted with later attempts to explain matter as electromagnetic field condensations.
Electromagnetic-only reduction fails; gravity, neutral particles and other interactions; source explicitly denies single universal motion law/force.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Scope that denial historically; do not imply no shared modern laws or prove future unification impossible.

entries.fact: Unity-of-matter heading; ordinary stellar/terrestrial/living/nonliving matter uses common atomic constituents.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Not every atom identical or all cosmic matter atomic.

entries.fact: Nucleus with protons/neutrons and surrounding electrons; electromagnetic photon mediation.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Three constituents not three fundamental species; hydrogen nucleus exception; electrons not classical orbiting pellets.

entries.fact: Pion model of nuclear forces; neutron decay neutrino; other particles/high energies.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Distinguish effective pion exchange from fundamental strong mediation; antineutrino in beta decay; avoid only-high-energy blanket claim.

entries.fact: Twentieth-century particle transformations.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Not unrestricted conversion of any particle into any other; enforce conservation/allowed processes.

entries.fact: Textbook places material unity and particles as forms of matter at the center of its worldview.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Distinguish historical philosophical formulation from empirical particle facts.

entries.fact: Modern-picture heading; unity of constituents and laws/interactions.
Four forces: gravity, electromagnetism, nuclear, weak; source restricts weak to transformations.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Strong versus residual nuclear distinction; weak scattering as well as decay; known framework not final exclusivity proof; not all four significant everywhere.

entries.fact: Quantum discoveries changed the classical physical picture.
Field/particle distinction loses absoluteness; photons/pions and wave-particle duality.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Pion not fundamental strong carrier; no established quantum gravity assumption or literal classical-wave/classical-particle identity.

entries.fact: Quantum probabilities and limitations on unique predictions.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Do not claim quantum state evolution necessarily random or all outcomes uncertain; some definite predictions allowed.

entries.fact: Quantum principles describe microscopic motion, interactions and transformations.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Do not imply complete quantum-gravity/unification theory established.

entries.fact: Unity alongside unanswered particle-property/unification questions and no fixed discovery timetable.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Separate textbook-era outlook from present theory; reflect established electroweak/Higgs developments without claiming full explanation.

entries.fact: Closing Galileo-attributed quotation and source-relative three-hundred-fifty-year wording.
entries.riskToResolveFromPrimaryEvidence: Preserve as textbook attribution; no newly verified archive quotation or present-relative date.
